page: Microsoft Azure M176ds_4_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It features 176 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is equipped with 3892.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 22.11 GB per vCPU. Local storage consists of a 410 GB SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents an enterprise-class hardware profile with high resource density, specifically targeting workloads requiring massive memory footprints. The qualitative tradeoff of this configuration is the high resource commitment required for the massive RAM capacity, which is balanced by the dedicated CPU allocation. However, users should note the absence of advanced CPU flags such as AVX-512, AMX, and SHA extensions in the reported capabilities, which may impact specific cryptographic or vector-processing workloads.

The M176ds_4_v3 is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale relational databases, in-memory databases, massive data warehousing, and enterprise resource planning systems that require substantial memory capacity alongside 176 dedicated vCPUs.
